note: Topic benchmark for the Phase 12 gate: primary exact, secondary as subset. Covers all eight categories, unclassifiable cases, and Hindi.

cases.title: State GDP growth pegged at 9.2 percent
cases.body: The economic survey pegged GDP growth at 9.2 per cent. The fiscal deficit stayed within limits while capital outlay rose, the finance department said.

cases.title: Educated youth unemployment worries survey
cases.body: Unemployment among educated youth is the central challenge, the survey says. Thousands of vacancies remain unfilled while job seekers multiply.

cases.title: Banks extend crop loans to small farmers
cases.body: Banks disbursed record crop loans this season. Officials said timely credit helped farmers buy seeds and fertiliser.

cases.title: Bihar Cabinet approves Patna Metro expansion
cases.body: Two metro corridors to Bihta will transform urban transport. The metro rail project enters its construction phase next year.

cases.title: Danapur-Bihta elevated road gets clearance
cases.body: The 20-km elevated road project received forest clearance. The bypass will decongest the highway corridor.

cases.title: Bridge over Sone opens for traffic
cases.body: The new bridge opened for light vehicles. Load testing for heavy traffic finishes next month on the river bridge.

cases.title: Bihta airport terminal work gathers pace
cases.body: The new terminal and runway at the Bihta airport will handle larger aircraft. The civil enclave opens next year under the UDAN scheme.

cases.title: New thermal power unit synchronised
cases.body: The thermal power unit was synchronised with the grid. Officials promised stable electricity supply and fewer outages.

cases.title: BIADA allots 120 plots at Bihta park
cases.body: Food processing units bagged most plots in the industrial area allotment. The industrial policy offers capital subsidy on land allotment.

cases.title: Ethanol plants get fresh interest subsidy
cases.body: Grain-based ethanol distilleries get interest subsidy. Twelve distilleries under construction will benefit from the decision.

cases.title: Textile park proposed in Bhagalpur
cases.body: A textile park for garment units was proposed. Handloom weavers will get common facility centres in the textile cluster.

cases.title: Startup policy offers seed support
cases.body: The startup policy supports small enterprises with seed funding. Young entrepreneurs welcomed the MSME package.

cases.title: Solar pumps reach 10,000 farmers
cases.body: Solar pumps transformed irrigation in pilot blocks. Farm mechanisation subsidies covered eighty percent of the cost.

cases.title: Paddy procurement crosses target
cases.body: Paddy procurement at mandis crossed the target. Farmers received minimum support price payments within days of the harvest.

cases.title: Dairy union adds chilling centres
cases.body: The dairy cooperative added milk chilling centres. Cattle owners and poultry farmers joined the expanded network.

cases.title: BPSC releases teacher recruitment calendar
cases.body: Examinations for 27,000 teacher posts will be held in December. Admit cards arrive a fortnight before each examination.

cases.title: Nalanda University opens new school
cases.body: The university campus will admit 120 students. The vice-chancellor announced new programmes starting next semester.

cases.title: Midday meal menu revised in schools
cases.body: Government schools revised the midday meal menu. Teachers welcomed better enrollment prospects from the school scheme.

cases.title: AIIMS OPD crosses one lakh patients
cases.body: The hospital outpatient department added beds and a trauma centre. AIIMS doctors managed the record OPD footfall.

cases.title: Immunisation drive covers remote blocks
cases.body: A public health immunisation drive reached remote blocks. ASHA workers led the vaccination campaign under the health scheme.

cases.title: Hospitals face doctor shortage
cases.body: Doctors and nurses posts lie vacant in district hospitals. The shortage of doctors affects emergency care, nurses said.

cases.title: Dengue cases rise in the capital
cases.body: The dengue outbreak spread across neighbourhoods. Health teams began fogging as encephalitis fears grew.

cases.title: Flood relief camps house 40,000
cases.body: Floods marooned villages along the river as embankments faced pressure. Relief camps line the river banks.

cases.title: Tiger reserve reports rise in count
cases.body: The tiger reserve estimated 56 big cats. Forest guards credited the sanctuary management and anti-poaching camps.

cases.title: City air turns severe in winter
cases.body: Air quality slid into the severe category as smog settled. Pollution control teams targeted dust and plastic waste burning.

cases.title: Wetland census finds new visitors
cases.body: The wetland census recorded migratory birds at oxbow lakes. Wetlands experts sought reserve status for the sites.

cases.title: CAG flags expenditure irregularities
cases.body: The audit flagged irregularities in scheme spending. Utilisation certificates were missing for large outlays, the report says.

cases.title: Land survey cuts pending disputes
cases.body: The revisional land survey published draft records. Mutation backlogs fell as jamabandi entries were corrected.

cases.title: Twelve officers transferred
cases.body: A transfer order moved twelve officers across districts. New postings take effect immediately, the notification says.

cases.title: Supreme Court upholds quota law
cases.body: The Supreme Court delivered its verdict on the reservation law. The judgment settles the tribunal debate over the breach.

cases.title: Relief operations scaled up
cases.body: The disaster management department opened relief camps. NDRF teams led evacuation as compensation surveys began.

cases.title: Panchayat bypolls announced
cases.body: Panchayat bypolls will be held next month. Ward-level municipal rolls were updated for the civic polls.

cases.title: Three arrested after robbery
cases.body: Police arrested three men for robbery. Officials cited improved patrolling and law and order drives.

cases.title: Actor tours three cities for film
cases.body: The actor will promote the new movie across cities. Fans gathered as the celebrity motorcade passed.

cases.title: State loses Ranji match
cases.body: Chasing 240, the team folded for 180. The captain blamed poor shot selection after the innings defeat.

cases.title: पटना मेट्रो विस्तार को मंजूरी
cases.body: मेट्रो परियोजना के विस्तार से शहरी परिवहन बदलेगा। मेट्रो रेल अगले साल निर्माण चरण में प्रवेश करेगी।

cases.title: शिक्षक नियुक्ति परीक्षा कैलेंडर जारी
cases.body: 27,000 पदों के लिए दिसंबर में परीक्षा होगी। प्रवेश पत्र परीक्षा से पहले जारी किए जाएंगे।

cases.title: पटना में लूट के बाद तीन गिरफ्तार
cases.body: पुलिस ने लूट के तीन आरोपियों को गिरफ्तार किया। अधिकारियों ने गश्त और कानून व्यवस्था का हवाला दिया।

cases.title: नल-जल योजना का दूसरा चरण
cases.body: हर घर नल योजना में छूटे टोलों को जोड़ा जाएगा। पेयजल आपूर्ति के लिए नई पाइपलाइन बिछेगी।
